note: Belt plan templates (resource.beltPlan). Columns are front to back (hotkeys 1..4); hp healing, mp mana, rv rejuvenation. Id 0 keeps the build's own plan (PlanForBuild). Tier follows the potion tier option and the plan's tier caps.

templates.name: balanced
templates.label: Balanced: two healing, one mana, one rejuvenation (rejuvenation is healing until the shop sells it)

templates.name: all health
templates.label: All healing potions
templates.risk: Casters run dry of mana and fight with the cheap attack.

templates.name: all mana
templates.label: All mana potions
templates.risk: No healing potion is bought; life can only be answered by the town portal and the walk home. Your call, risky.

templates.label: Three healing columns to one mana column
Healing and mana in equal parts

templates.name: rejuv only
templates.label: Rejuvenation only
templates.risk: Expensive; early on the shop does not sell it, so the belt stays empty.
